name: Amoeba (Amoeba proteus)
short_description: Large free-living freshwater single cell (~250–750 µm) with no fixed shape: it crawls on blunt lobopodia by cytoplasmic streaming and engulfs its prey. Harmless to humans — the textbook example of a cell that crawls and eats, exactly as our macrophages do. Not Entamoeba histolytica.

textbook.1: ❌ FAIL — science correct (naked cell, blunt lobopodia, one discoid nucleus, contractile vacuole, food vacuoles with engulfed alga and ciliate, uroid), but a style outlier: heavy teal double contours and a die-cut sticker look instead of the house hairline-outline plate (cf. rod-bacterium/parasite textbook).
textbook.2: ✅ PASS — same correct anatomy, now in house style: near-invisible hairline boundaries, muted dusty palette, soft airbrushed shading, distinct clear ectoplasm rim against the granular amber endoplasm, quarter cut-away, neutral charcoal ground, full-bleed, no baked text.

sem.1: ❌ FAIL — surface texture and false-colour are right, but the cell is drawn as a near-symmetric six-armed 'starfish' with equal stubby arms: no leading pseudopod, no uroid, hence no polarity. Violates the 'no regular/symmetric shape' rule.
sem.2: ✅ PASS — asymmetric naked cell with blunt lobopodia gripping the substrate, one broad leading pseudopod, a wrinkled trailing uroid, soft folded membrane surface. No wall, no flagella, no cilia, no spikes; surface only, which is correct for SEM. Warm ochre on cool grey-blue, full-bleed, no baked text.

3d.1: ✅ PASS — translucent gel-like body with subsurface scattering, blunt lobopodia, clear glassy ectoplasm rim, granular amber endoplasm, exactly one blue-violet discoid nucleus, one pale-cyan contractile vacuole and several olive/brown food vacuoles (one with an engulfed alga), wrinkled uroid at the rear. Natural biological tints, clean seamless dark studio ground, no border, no baked text.

watercolor.1: ❌ FAIL — full-bleed aged paper and the right painterly register, but the science is wrong: a second nucleus-like lilac body sits beside the true nucleus, so the cell reads as binucleate. Also the trailing end is drawn as long stringy filaments rather than a wrinkled uroid.
watercolor.2: ✅ PASS — one nucleus only; blunt lobopodia, clear ectoplasm rim, speckled endoplasm, pale-cyan contractile vacuole, olive food vacuoles with an engulfed alga, properly wrinkled uroid. Warm aged paper fills the whole frame corner to corner with a soft darker wash halo behind the subject — no sheet-on-a-surface, no mat, no frame, no baked text.

reference: ✅ PASS — a single living Amoeba proteus in the classic polypodial locomotive form: seven or eight blunt, rounded lobopodia, granular endoplasm with crystals, clear rim at the pseudopod tips, one discoid nucleus and one round contractile vacuole. Naked cell — no wall, no test, no flagella, no cilia. CC BY-SA 4.0, SmallRex / Wikimedia Commons. Padded (not cropped) to square so no pseudopodia are lost; the cleaned real-02 adds a natural warm false-colour to the greyscale DIC original without altering the shape.
decision: re-rendered for house style; hairline outlines
